bestiary.dmIntro: Monster templates – one database shared by all Dungeon Masters. Only visible in stories where you are the Dungeon Master; players never see it. In combat, use them via “Add monster” or “Add ally”.
bestiary.playerIntro: Shared monster notebook of your group “{{name}}”: all players can add and extend entries. The DM's data is not included here.
bestiary.readOnlyIntro: Players' monster database of “{{name}}” – what the group has found out about monsters. Read-only for you.

bestiary.unknownHint: Leave AC and HP empty if you don't know them (yet).
bestiary.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from the database.
bestiary.saveAsTemplate: Also save as a template in the DM database
bestiary.dmOnlyHint: Only the DM sees attack and description.
bestiary.damageHint: Same as for spells, e.g. 1d6+2 or 2d8+4. Leave empty if no damage.
bestiary.hpRangeHint: HP as a number or range (e.g. 10-15) – leave empty if unknown.
bestiary.combatAttackHint: Shown on the monster in the combat tab (DM only) – e.g. its main attack with damage.

storyView.title: View
storyView.hint: In story view, character sheet, info board and combat lead directly to this story.

storyView.filteredCharacters: Story view “{{name}}” – only this story's sheets.

stories.title: Stories
stories.hint: Stories are created here and appear automatically on the info board and in combat. The role per story (player or Dungeon Master) decides what someone sees and may do there.
stories.membersHint: Players see the story's info board and encounters and write posts. Dungeon Masters run encounters, see hidden values, manage posts and read the story's character sheets. Without an entry the story is invisible (the admin has DM rights everywhere unless listed as a player).
stories.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted with all {{count}} posts, encounters and the players' monster database. Archive it instead to hide it.
stories.lifestylesHint: These values apply to all character sheets assigned to this story: the lifestyle is chosen on the sheet, the daily expenses come from here. New stories start with the Player's Handbook defaults.

lifestyleError.name: Every lifestyle needs a name.
lifestyleError.duplicate: Each lifestyle may only appear once.

stories.languagesHint: These languages are available on character sheets of this story. New stories start with all languages from the wiki; deselect some here or add your own.
stories.toolsHint: Additional entries for “Tools & other” on the character sheet. The tools themselves come from the wiki (tools) or this story’s items; use this list only for entries not listed there. While the default list is active it is not shown in addition.
stories.godsHint: These gods are suggested and linked for “Faith / deity” on character sheets. New stories start with all gods from the wiki; pick the ones that exist in your world or add your own.
stories.sourcesHint: Which books apply in this story. With the story active, spell list, spellbook and wiki only show content from these sources, and the character wizard, character sheet and level up only offer these. “Homebrew / no source” covers custom spells and entries without a source.
stories.sourcesNone: No source selected – no content would be available in this story.
stories.dmHint: As Dungeon Master you edit the settings of your stories here (sources, lifestyles, languages, gods, tools). Name and members are managed by admins and moderators.

items.title: Magic items
items.hint: One shared database for all stories – maintained by the admin, moderators and all Dungeon Masters. Holders are assigned per story: pick the story above, then tick the character sheets. Players are notified and see the item on their sheet.
items.empty: No magic items in the database yet.
items.noStories: You don't run a story yet. Magic items are managed by the admin, moderators and all Dungeon Masters.
items.holdersHint: Character sheets of this story (character sheet → settings). Several possible; holders in other stories stay unchanged.
items.noCharacters: No character sheets are assigned to this story yet.
items.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from the shared database and removed from all character sheets – in every story.
items.sheetHint: This character's magic items – click a card for all details. There you can pass an item to another character of the story or return it to the DM.
items.sheetHintReadOnly: This character's magic items – click a card for all details.
items.sheetEmpty: This character has no magic items yet.
items.noTargets: No other characters in the story

items.returnText: “{{item}}” is returned to the DM and removed from this sheet.
items.attuneHint: You can attune to magic items your character owns that require attunement ("Magic items" tab).
items.attunementHint: Only items that require attunement can be chosen as attuned items on the character sheet.
items.onlyThisStory: Only items held in this story
items.chooseStoryForHolders: Choose a story above to assign holders.

catalog.title: Items
catalog.standardHint: Armor, weapons and gear for all character sheets without a story. Stories inherit this database and can adjust it under Admin → Stories → Edit story. Prefilled with the 5e basics (SRD).
catalog.storyHint: This story uses the standard database. Entries can be adjusted (✎), hidden (eye) or reset for this story, and own entries added. Changes are saved immediately; later changes to the standard arrive automatically unless an entry was adjusted.
catalog.storyAfterCreate: Items can be adjusted here once the story has been created.
catalog.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from the standard database – including all adjustments in stories.
catalog.deleteStoryText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from this story.
catalog.revertText: The adjustment of “{{name}}” in this story is discarded; the standard entry applies again.

dmNotes.hint: Only visible to this story's Dungeon Masters – players don't see this tab.
dmNotes.empty: No notes yet. Create sections, e.g. “Village A”, and note what can happen there.

sources.title: Sources
sources.hint: Books that can be chosen as a source throughout the app – in the wiki (all tabs), for spells, magic items and in the monster databases. Maintained by the admin and moderators.
sources.name: Name
sources.usage: Used by: {{wiki}} wiki entries · {{catalog}} items · {{magicItems}} magic items · {{spells}} spells · {{monsters}} monsters

sources.renameHint: Renaming updates spells and monsters with this source automatically.

backup.sectionHint: All app data in one file – for backups and moving to another server. The individual exports below remain for partial transfers.
backup.exportText: Downloads all data as one JSON file: users, spells, spellbooks, character sheets (with images), stories, info board, DM notes, encounters, bestiary, magic items, item database, wiki and sources.
backup.sensitive: The file contains the password hashes of all users and all private content – keep it safe.
backup.importText: Restores a full backup. All current data is completely replaced by the content of the file.
backup.notABackup: This file is not a Zauberbuch full backup.
backup.warning: Before importing, the server automatically stores a safety copy of the current database in /data/backups. You may need to sign in again afterwards.
backup.confirmText: All current data will be deleted and replaced by {{count}} records from the backup. This affects all users.
backup.safetyCopy: The previous database is stored as /data/backups/{{file}}.

wizard.title: New character
wizard.intro: The wizard guides you through creating a level 1 character. Race, class and background come from the wiki; ability scores, saving throws, skills, proficiencies, hit points, languages, tools and features are filled in automatically. You can adjust everything in the sheet afterwards.
wizard.name: Character name
wizard.spellsLater: This class casts spells from level 2.
wizard.noBackgrounds: The wiki has no backgrounds yet – you can skip this step.
wizard.rollPersonality: Roll personality trait, ideal, bond and flaw from the background tables

methodHint.standard: Assign 15, 14, 13, 12, 10 and 8 to the six abilities – each value exactly once.
methodHint.pointBuy: All abilities start at 8; you have {{budget}} points. Scores up to 13 cost 1 point each, 14 and 15 cost 2 each.
methodHint.manual: Enter your own values or roll (4d6, drop the lowest).

wizard.chooseSkills: Choose {{count}} skills of the {{cls}} class ({{done}} chosen):
wizard.noSkillChoice: The class has no skill choices.
wizard.summaryHint: Add spells and appearance afterwards in the sheet.

wizard.noEquipment: Class and background have no starting equipment in the wiki.
wizard.linkedItem: linked to the item database (weight and card)
wizard.toolsAsItems: Tools you are proficient with are added to the inventory too: {{list}}
wizard.unpackPacks: Unpack equipment packs (e.g. explorer’s pack) into individual items
wizard.storyIntro: Which story does the character play in? The wizard then only offers races, classes, subclasses, backgrounds and items from the story’s sources and its languages. The character is assigned to the story right away.
wizard.noStoryHint: All content; the story can be assigned later in the sheet settings.
wizard.excludedLanguages: Not available in the story “{{story}}” and therefore not added: {{list}}
